arStrings.szText: Dash onto an enemy and slash them.

{c_important}Shred{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed and Heals for {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_8)]){/c} if an enemy is struck.

Your Claws are electrically charged allowing {c_important}Shred{/c} to deal {c_number}[SF_38*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage as Lightning.

{c_important}Shred{/c} becomes a {c_important}Storm{/c} Skill.
{c_important}Shred's{/c} third combo attack becomes a powerful 360 degree swipe that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_ATTACK_THREE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Shred's{/c} first attack gains a {c_number}[SF_39*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance and {c_number}[SF_40*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage bonus.
{c_important}Shred{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} seconds. Subsequent casts extend this duration up to a maximum of {c_number}[SF_32]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Shred{/c} Heals for {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_8)]){/c} if an enemy is struck.

Healing is increased to {c_number}[{SF_8}*2*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax() * SF_8*2)]){/c} when striking a Poisoned enemy.

Critical Strikes with {c_important}Shred{/c} restore {c_number}[SF_19]{/c} Spirit. 

Striking a Poisoned enemy instead grants {c_number}[SF_19*2]{/c} Spirit.
